title: Big Weaponsmith
description: Replaces a Weaponsmith with the well-known Big Boss.
body:
Replaces a Weaponsmith with the well-known **Big Boss** and makes several other changes:
- Changed the **"What a Great Deal!"** and **"Stealth 100"** advancements
- Changed the sound of Weaponsmith working (and added iconic meow of the Revolver Ocelot)
- Changed the Splashes

**Translations:** English (all variants), Russian, Belarusian and several other languages ​​:D


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

_P.S. Even though the game says the resource pack is "Incompatible" on versions earlier than 1.21, in theory it should work up to 1.14._

</details>
